Khương Nha- khuongnha.vn@gmail.com22/11/2026 07:26 GMT+7Chia sẻChọn BáoThanh Niênlàmnguồn ưu tiêntrên Google tìm kiếm.Xem hướng dẫn.BƯỚC1Nhấp vào nút"ThêmThanh Niêntrên Google"hoặc mở trực tiếp đường dẫn này:https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=thanhnien.vnBƯỚC2Tại trang vừa mở, tìm dòng"BáoThanh Niên"và bấm vào ô vuông bên phải.Khi ô vuông chuyển thành dấu tích xanh là bạn đã thành công rồi!LƯU Ý NHỎ:Nếu muốn kiểm tra xem cài đặt còn hiệu lực không, bạn chỉ cầnmở lại link trênlà thấy ngaydấu tích xanhvẫn đang hiển thị.Chúc bạn đọc báo vui vẻ!
vivo V80 và V80 FE hướng đến người dùng trẻ, tập trung vào thiết kế bắt mắt với hiệu ứng thị giác lạ mắt trên mặt lưng và camera chuyên chụp chân dung.
vivo vừa giới thiệu đến người dùng Việt Nam hai smartphone mới là V80 và V80 FE. Điểm nhấn của máy nằm ở mặt lưng dùng kính điêu khắc lạnh nguyên khối, kết hợp khung viền kim loại. Phiên bản màu tím dùng hiệu ứng tinh hà 3D đổi sắc theo góc nhìn nhờ công nghệ quang khắc laser holographic. Hai phiên bản màu xanh và xám cũng sở hữu thiết kế mặt lưng bắt mắt.
Trong khi đó, phiên bản giá rẻ V80 FE nổi bật với màu vàng khi dùng các chi tiết gợi nhớ hình ảnh những chùm pháo hoa rực sáng trên bầu trời. V80 FE có thêm hai lựa chọn màu xanh và đen.
Hệ thống camera vivo V80 được đồng chế tác cùng ZEISS, kết hợp các tiêu cự chân dung chuyên biệt. Camera siêu tele ZEISS 50 MP, hỗ trợ zoom quang 3x, dùng cảm biến Sony IMX882. Máy được trang bị camera tiềm vọng và chống rung quang học OIS.
vivo V80 phiên bản màu xanh với ống kính chân dung chuyên dụng, đa tiêu cự
Chế độ chân dung ZEISS 85 mm mang đến hiệu ứng bokeh ZEISS Sonnar đặc trưng cùng tông màu xanh lam - vàng phong cách điện ảnh. Trong khi đó, chế độ chân dung C-Bit ZEISS 100 mm sử dụng hiệu ứng bokeh ZEISS Planar cùng tông bạch kim có độ bão hòa thấp, tập trung vào biểu cảm và chi tiết gương mặt.
Hệ thống camera ZEISS trên vivo V80 gồm ống kính chính 50 MP (Sony LYTIA 700V), camera góc siêu rộng và camera selfie nhóm 50 MP, tự động lấy nét. Cả ống kính trước và sau đều hỗ trợ quay video 4K 60 fps.

Đánh giá vivo V80: Có gì để cạnh tranh iPhone 17e, Galaxy S26 FE?
(Dân trí) - Trong phân khúc cận cao cấp, vivo V80 đối đầu trực diện với hàng loạt đối thủ như iPhone 17e, Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, OPPO Reno16 Pro và Xiaomi 17T Pro.
- Thiết kế mỏng nhẹ, màn hình hiển thị tốt.
vivo V80 phù hợp với nhóm người dùng mua sắm máy mới, cần một chiếcđiện thoạibền bỉ, màn hình đẹp, pin khỏe và chụp ảnh chân dung tốt. Tuy vậy, sản phẩm chưa đủ thuyết phục với nhóm người dùng yêu thích chơi game.
So với phiên bản V70 ra mắt hồi đầu năm, thiết kế tổng thể trên vivo V80 có phần vuông vức hơn. Máy được hoàn thiện từ mặt lưng kính cùng khung viền nhôm cứng cáp, với độ mỏng 7,7mm cùng trọng lượng 203g. Các góc cạnh được bo cong nhẹ nhàng mang lại cảm giác cầm nắm thoải mái, ôm sát lòng bàn tay mà không hề gây cấn tay.
Phần mặt lưng cũng được thiết kế với hiệu ứng ánh sao nổi dạng 3D có thể thay đổi màu sắc tùy theo góc nhìn, đặc biệt phù hợp với người dùng trẻ tuổi yêu thích thiết kế thời trang, mới mẻ. Tuy vậy, mặt lưng kính bóng bám lại khá nhiều dấu vân tay trong quá trình sử dụng.
Điểm nhấn trên mặt lưng nằm ở cụm mô-đun camera được mở rộng theo bề ngang, bên cạnh là logo ZEISS và đèn thông báo LED dạng tròn. Ngoài ra, sản phẩm cũng đạt chuẩn kháng nước và bụi IP68/IP69, giúp người dùng yên tâm hơn khi sử dụng thiết bị trong nhiều điều kiện môi trường khác nhau.
Tương tự phiên bản tiền nhiệm, màn hình của vivo V80 có kích thước 6,59inch, sử dụng tấm nền AMOLED với độ phân giải 2.750 x 1.260 pixel. Tuy vậy, tần số quét đã được nâng cấp lên 144Hz, giúp các thao tác vuốt màn hình và cuộn trang trở nên mượt mà hơn.
Màn hình này hỗ trợ hiển thị 1 tỷ màu và chuẩn HDR10+, cho màu sắc hiển thị rực rỡ, màu đen sâu và góc nhìn rộng. Độ sáng tối đa đạt mức 5.000nit, có thể hiển thị tốt các nội dung ở ngoài trời nắng gắt. Một điểm cộng khác là các cạnh viền được làm mỏng đều, giúp tăng diện tích hiển thị lên 90% không gian mặt trước.
Máy cũng tích hợp cảm biến vân tay dưới màn hình. Đáng chú ý, đây là vân tay siêu âm 3D chứ không phải loại vân tay quang học như nhiều đối thủ trong cùng phân khúc. Trang bị này giúp máy có thể nhận diện vân tay nhanh và chính xác, ngay cả khi ngón tay của người dùng bị ướt.
Camera chính hoạt động tốt, góc rộng còn hạn chế
Trên V80, vivo tiếp tục đồng hành cùng ZEISS để tinh chỉnh hệ thống ống kính. Cụm camera này bao gồm ống kính chính 50MP hỗ trợ chống rung quang học OIS, ống kính tele 50MP hỗ trợ zoom quang học 3x và ống kính góc siêu rộng 8MP.
Trải nghiệm thực tế qua các bức ảnh chụp ban ngày, camera chính và camera tele cho thấy khả năng bắt nét nhanh và đo sáng chính xác.
Bức ảnh chụp cận cảnh cánh hoa tái hiện chính xác dải màu từ sắc đỏ thắm đến viền vàng chấm cam. Các đường vân trên cánh hoa hiện lên sắc nét, trong khi phông nền lá xanh phía sau được làm mờ nhẹ nhàng, tạo độ nổi khối chủ thể tự nhiên.
Ở bức ảnh chụp cánh diều bay, camera tái tạo chi tiết hoa văn trên thân diều, sợi dây cước mảnh cũng được thể hiện rõ ràng. Ngay cả khi chụp những con diều nhỏ đang bay ở khoảng cách xa, ống kính vẫn giữ được hình khối tách bạch, không bị bệt hay vỡ nét.
Bức ảnh chụp toàn cảnh bờ sông Sài Gòn nhìn về phía các tòa nhà lúc sập tối tái hiện khung cảnh lung linh với bóng đèn phản chiếu trên mặt nước. Nền trời chuyển màu xanh thẫm. Các ô cửa kính sáng đèn của các tòa cao ốc như Bitexco hay Times Square vẫn giữ được chi tiết.
Khi chụp trong nhà hàng với ánh sáng nhân tạo, bức ảnh chụp món cá áp chảo trên đĩa sứ trắng mang lại độ chi tiết cao, từ thớ cá chín rắc tiêu, sắc cam sánh mịn của phần sốt nghiền cho đến nhánh rau xanh bên trên đều thể hiện độ tương phản cao, tạo cảm giác kích thích thị giác.
Với chế độ chụp ảnh chân dung, vivo V80 hỗ trợ 5 mức tiêu cự tương ứng 23mm, 35mm, 50mm, 85mm và 100mm. Thuật toán nhận diện chủ thể hoạt động chính xác, bóc tách người và phông nền phía sau một cách mượt mà và tự nhiên. Những vùng chuyển tiếp phức tạp như lọn tóc ven và đường viền trang phục đều được giữ lại nguyên vẹn mà không bị hiện tượng xóa lẹm hay tạo cảm giác giả.
Ở mặt trước, camera selfie 50MP có khẩu độ f/2.0 tích hợp khả năng tự động lấy nét cùng góc chụp rộng 92 độ. Camera này có thể phục vụ nhu cầu chụp ảnh chân dung nhóm đông người trong điều kiện ánh sáng đa dạng.
Dù vậy, camera góc siêu rộng 8MP vẫn là điểm trừ tương tự thế hệ trước. Chất lượng ảnh góc rộng có phần nhạt hơn và dễ suy giảm chi tiết khi chụp trong điều kiện ánh sáng yếu.
Hiệu suất ổn định nhưng thiếu cải tiến
vivo V80 tích hợp bộ xử lý Qualcomm Snapdragon 7 Gen 4, dung lượng RAM 8GB cùng bộ nhớ 256GB. Trên thực tế, con chip này đã được hãng trang bị phiên bản tiền nhiệm. Do đó, hiệu suất tổng thể của máy gần như không có nhiều cải tiến.
Đánh giá thông qua phần mềm chấm điểm hiệu suất AnTuTu Benchmark V12, máy đạt khoảng 1,3-1,4 triệu điểm. Với bài kiểm tra 3DMark Wild Life Stress Test, máy cũng đạt độ ổn định trên 80% sau 20 phút hoạt động liên tục ở mức thiết lập hiệu suất cao.
Trong quá trình trải nghiệm hàng ngày, máy có thể xử lý ổn định mọi tác vụ lướt web, mạng xã hội và xem video, cũng như chơi các tựa game phổ biến như Liên Quân Mobile hay PUBG Mobile. Tuy nhiên, việc giữ nguyên chip qua nhiều thế hệ khiến V80 có phần lép vế về mặt sức mạnh đồ họa trước các đối thủ cùng tầm giá.
Với những tựa game có đồ họa nặng như Genshin Impact hay Where Winds Meet, người dùng sẽ cần chủ động hạ mức thiết lập đồ họa để có khung hình tốt hơn. Bù lại, hệ thống tản nhiệt của máy hoạt động khá hiệu quả, giúp duy trì hiệu suất xử lý ổn định trong thời gian dài.
Về phần mềm, vivo V80 được cài sẵn giao diện OriginOS 7 chạy trên nền tảng Android 17. Giao diện này có thiết kế tối giản, chuyển động mượt. Bộ công cụ AI trên vivo V80 tương đối đa dạng và có thể cạnh tranh sòng phẳng với các đối thủ như Galaxy S26 FE hay OPPO Reno16 Pro.
Viên pin trên V80 được nâng cấp lên dung lượng 7.200mAh, giúp người dùng có thể yên tâm sử dụng thiết bị trong hơn một ngày. Máy cũng hỗ trợ sạc nhanh với công suất 90W, cho phép sạc đầy 100% dung lượng khoảng một giờ.
Xét trong cùng phân khúc, vivo V80 cạnh tranh trực tiếp với một số đối thủ như iPhone 17e, Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, OPPO Reno16 Pro, Xiaomi 17T Pro và Honor 600 Pro.
Thiết bị ghi điểm nhờ thiết kế mỏng nhẹ, thời trang kết hợp cùng độ bền bỉ cao. Máy sở hữu màn hình AMOLED chất lượng, thời lượng sử dụng pin tốt cùng camera chính cho khả năng hoạt động ổn định trong nhiều điều kiện sử dụng.

Các góc cạnh được bo cong nhẹ nhàng mang lại cảm giác cầm nắm thoải mái, ôm sát lòng bàn tay mà không hề gây cấn tay.
Phần mặt lưng cũng được thiết kế với hiệu ứng ánh sao nổi dạng 3D có thể thay đổi màu sắc tùy theo góc nhìn, đặc biệt phù hợp với người dùng trẻ tuổi yêu thích thiết kế thời trang, mới mẻ.

article.title: Waymo triệu hồi robotaxi sau sự cố đi vào làn đường cao tốc bị đóng
article.summary: Waymo vừa thực hiện hai đợt triệu hồi tự nguyện đối với hệ thống lái tự động sau khi các phương tiện của hãng liên tục đi vào khu vực thi công trên cao tốc, dẫn đến lệnh cấm từ cơ quan chức năng California.
body: Hãng xe tự lái Waymo, thuộc sở hữu của Alphabet, vừa chính thức thực hiện hai đợt triệu hồi tự nguyện đối với hệ thống lái tự động trên đội xe robotaxi của mình. Quyết định này được đưa ra sau khi các phương tiện của hãng liên tục ghi nhận các hành vi vi phạm an toàn, bao gồm việc tự ý đi vào các làn đường cao tốc đang bị đóng cửa để thi công và không tuân thủ các tín hiệu điều tiết giao thông từ lực lượng chức năng.

Trước đó, Sở Phương tiện Cơ giới California (DMV) đã ban hành lệnh cấm Waymo hoạt động trên các tuyến cao tốc của tiểu bang. Cơ quan này khẳng định các robotaxi của Waymo là 'mối nguy hiểm sắp xảy ra đối với an toàn công cộng' sau khi ghi nhận nhiều sự cố, điển hình là việc ba xe tự lái đi vào khu vực thi công bị hạn chế tại thành phố Burlingame. Ngoài ra, một video lan truyền trên mạng xã hội cũng cho thấy một chiếc Waymo cố gắng điều hướng xung quanh xe của cảnh sát tuần tra cao tốc California khi lực lượng này đang thực hiện phân luồng giao thông.

Đây không phải là lần đầu tiên Waymo gặp rắc rối với công nghệ điều hướng trên cao tốc. Hồi tháng 6, hãng từng triệu hồi gần 3.800 xe sau các sự cố tương tự. Dù đã tung ra bản cập nhật phần mềm vào tháng 7 nhằm cải thiện khả năng nhận diện khu vực thi công và phản ứng với xe ưu tiên, các sự cố gần đây cho thấy hệ thống vẫn chưa đạt được độ ổn định cần thiết. Hiện tại, Waymo đã tạm dừng hoạt động trên cao tốc tại tất cả các thị trường mà hãng đang vận hành để đánh giá lại hiệu suất.

Waymo cho biết hãng đang tích cực làm việc với DMV và các cơ quan quản lý để khắc phục lỗi phần mềm. Trong thời gian chờ đợi, dịch vụ gọi xe của Waymo vẫn tiếp tục hoạt động bình thường trên các tuyến đường nội đô, nơi hãng đang phục vụ hơn nửa triệu chuyến đi mỗi tuần. Công ty khẳng định các đợt triệu hồi này là bước đi cần thiết trong quy trình kiểm chứng công nghệ trước khi mở rộng sang các môi trường giao thông phức tạp hơn.

article.title: Tuyển Anh giành chiến thắng cách biệt kỷ lục trước New Zealand tại Nations Championship
article.summary: Đội tuyển rugby union Anh đã thể hiện phong độ ấn tượng để đánh bại New Zealand với tỷ số 37-12, thiết lập cột mốc chiến thắng cách biệt lớn nhất trong lịch sử đối đầu giữa hai đội.
body: Đội tuyển rugby union Anh vừa tạo nên cột mốc lịch sử khi giành chiến thắng áp đảo 37-12 trước New Zealand trong khuôn khổ giải đấu Nations Championship. Trận đấu chứng kiến sự lấn lướt hoàn toàn của đội chủ nhà ngay từ những phút đầu tiên tại sân vận động Allianz.

Henry Slade là người mở tỷ số cho tuyển Anh ngay ở phút thứ tư trận đấu. Sau hiệp một khép lại với lợi thế dẫn trước 19-5, đội chủ nhà tiếp tục duy trì thế trận chắc chắn. Dù Beauden Barrett ghi dấu ấn trong trận đấu thứ 150 cho tuyển New Zealand bằng một pha lập công giúp thu hẹp khoảng cách xuống 12-24, nhưng đó là tất cả những gì đội khách làm được trước khi chiến thuật thay người và sức mạnh từ dàn dự bị của Anh phát huy tác dụng.

Seb Atkinson ấn định chiến thắng thuyết phục bằng cú lội ngược dòng ghi try thứ năm cho đội chủ nhà sau đường chuyền tinh tế từ Marcus Smith. Kết quả này đánh dấu khoảng cách chiến thắng lớn nhất của tuyển Anh trước đối thủ trong suốt lịch sử 121 năm đối đầu, đồng thời phản ánh chuỗi trận đầy khó khăn của New Zealand sau chuyến lưu đấu kéo dài.

Where You Can Find Which GPU You Have In Your Windows PC
Where you can find which GPU you have in your Windows PC
Finding your GPU takes a few built-in Windows tools and no screwdriver.
ByHusain ParvezNov. 21, 2026 11:00 am ESTStenko Vlad/ShutterstockAdd Engadget on Google:Preferred SourceGoogle Discover
In case you didn't know, your Windows computer can house two graphics processors, and the one powering up your display isn't always the one keeping those games running. Some laptops juggle integrated graphics for everyday use and a dedicated NVIDIA, AMD or Intel GPU for heavier workloads. An Intel or AMD sticker on your system doesn't always tell you the whole story.
Confirming a game's requirements, troubleshooting system performance or deciding if your PC could use an upgrade first needs a proper look at the internals. Thanks torising GPU pricesand AI data centers putting pressure on memory supplies, PC builders are already bearing the brunt of it. It's best to know how capable your current setup is before you burn a hole in your wallet.
The good part is that Windows can easily identify your graphics hardware for you without needing any additional software or taking a screwdriver to your PC. While Task Manager is the fastest way to go about it, there are a couple of other built-in tools you can use when the details are hidden in fine print.
Your GPU is already listed in Task Manager
Windows' Task Manager can do more than just flag which apps and services are eating up your computer's resources. The Performance section gives you a clear look at the graphics card and spells out the details about its memory, driver and even the current workload it is under.
To open Task Manager, pressCtrl + Shift + Esc.
From the left sidebar in Windows 11, choosePerformanceor click the Performance tab at the top in Windows 10.
Click onGPU 0and find the model name of the graphics processor in the upper-right corner.
If you can seeGPU 1or other entries, take a look at those too.
Don't take the numbering of the GPUs at face value. For instance, GPU 0 isn't always assigned to the more powerful graphics card or the one that's running all your games. Windows simply labels the GPUs based on hardware location, and this has nothing to do with their performance.
You'll also find dedicated and shared GPU memory right under the performance graphs. Dedicated memory usually refers tothe amount of VRAMthat's available on a dedicated GPU, while shared memory is regular system RAM that the GPU borrows when needed. Some integrated GPUs even have a portion of system RAM reserved for graphics. Windows reports this as dedicated memory, but an integrated GPU mostly relies on the system RAM.
Besides the GPU branding, you also get driver details, info about DirectX and even GPU temperature (if the hardware supports it) in Task Manager.
Your PC's Device Manager is exactly where you need to look for your GPU's name without any graphs involved. To begin, right-click theStartbutton, selectDevice Managerfrom the list andexpandDisplay adapters. You'll find all the graphics devices listed by Windows and also see whether your PC has both integrated and dedicated GPUs. Once you find the GPU you want, double-click on it and open theDrivertab to check the installed driver version and date.
There's also the option to use the DirectX Diagnostic Tool. PressWindows + R, typedxdiagand hit Enter. TheDisplaytab will give you details about the GPU and drivers installed, and theSystemtab shows the DirectX version installed on your system.
If you seeMicrosoft Basic Display Adapterinstead of your graphics card's name in Device Manager, it means Windows is using a generic display driver. While that doesn't always point to hardware issues, you may want toupdate your GPU driversbefore getting deeper into troubleshooting.
You can also use third-party apps like HWiNFO to track GPU temperatures, clock speeds and power readings, just as you wouldwhen checking CPU temperatures.

How to verify AI shopping deals to avoid scamsSkip Navigation
MarketsBusinessInvestingTechPolitics & PolicyVideoWatchlistInvesting ClubPROLivestreamMenu
About 16% of respondents in a Norton-commissioned survey said they had been scammed while shopping online during the holidays.
AI can help scammers create convincing fake stores, while shopping assistants may recommend unfamiliar sellers, Norton's Leyla Bilge said.
Verify unfamiliar sellers independently, compare reviews across sources and use a credit card when possible, consumer experts say.
watch nowVIDEO0:5000:50Can AI find the best holiday deals?Personal Finance
Artificial intelligenceshopping toolscan help consumers compare prices and find gift ideas, but experts say shoppers still need to verify unfamiliarretailersand sellers before buying.
Scammers can use AI to make fake stores, product photos and reviews look convincing. It can also make creating and deploying websites easier, said Leyla Bilge, global head of scam research at cybersecurity company Norton.
"The biggest impact right now we're seeing in AI is on coding," Bilge said. Scammers can register "thousands and thousands of fake e-shops online," she said, which increases the chances shoppers will encounter one.
ANorton surveyof 1,000 U.S. adults found that 16% of respondents had been scammed while shopping online during the holidays. Of those victims, 88% lost money, with an average loss of $394. The survey was conducted from an opt-in online panel between Sept. 10 and 21 by Dynata on behalf of Norton's parent company, Gen.
Here's a look at more stories on how to manage, grow and protect your money for the years ahead.

Inheriting a home can leave siblings with financial headaches — how to avoid mistakes
Is the K-shaped economy ending? Finance pros weigh in

AI can help find holiday deals — but it's not great at spotting scams, experts say
Scams can have impacts beyond financial losses. In asurveyof 3,110 U.S. adults released in June, the Global Anti-Scam Alliance found that 82% of respondents had encountered a scam in the past year. More than half, 59%, said the scam affected their mental well-being.
More than half of GASA survey respondents said they had experienced repeat scams.
If you put your address or phone number in an AI tool that turns out to be fraudulent, "you might get reached out to again with a much more sophisticated, much more targeted and personalized attack and scam," Bilge said.
AI recommendations need a second look
Among respondents who had used an AI shopping assistant or agent, 56% said it had recommended or completed a purchase from a retailer they didn't recognize, the Norton survey found.
An agent focused on finding the lowest price may steer a shopper toward an unfamiliar seller, so experts say shoppers shouldn't treat its recommendation as vetted.
"You absolutely need to check with the retailer directly," said Matt Schulz, chief consumer finance analyst at LendingTree and author of "Ask Questions, Save Money, Make More."
watch nowVIDEO1:4101:41Dynamic pricing explainedPersonal Finance
Bilge said many shoppers make purchases on their phones through social media, sometimes with a single click, leaving them little time or incentive to assess where the link goes. Then, some still buy even if they're unsure of the site's legitimacy.
The Norton survey also found that 35% of Americans had bought from a website or seller they thought might be a scam because the deal seemed too good to pass up.
Before buying from a seller or retailer, consumer experts recommend thesesteps:
Go directly to a retailer's official website or app.Don't rely solely on a link from an AI tool or social media ad.
Look for reputation red flags.Search the seller's name with terms such as "complaint" or "scam."
Compare reviews across multiple sites.TheFederal Trade Commissioncautions that reviews and ratings can be fake or misleading.
Verify the seller, even if the site uses "https."The FTC notes that "https" means a site is encrypted, not that the seller is legitimate.
Pause before buying.Schulz recommends trying the "24-hour rule." Put the item in your cart, step away, and decide the next day whether you still want it. The pause can help prevent buyer's remorse and give you time to check for scam warning signs before you pay.
While AI can narrow gift options and find the lowest prices, experts say shoppers should verify the store before handing over payment details — and, when possible, pay by credit card. Keep order details and receipts, too.
The FTC says cardholders can dispute charges in certain cases, such as when merchandise never arrives.

Where are the most jobs for 18-24 year-olds? - BBC News
Image source,Getty ImagesByTommy Lumby,Business data journalistandNick Edser,Business reporter
If you're one of the nearly one million people aged 16-24 not in education, employment or training - otherwise known as "Neet" - then you might be wondering where to start.
Under-25s should be guaranteed job placements or training to help them find permanent work, a major review aimed at cutting the number of Neets will say.
But how many jobs are there where you live? Use our look-up tool to find out.
Burnham wants Neets report to be watershed moment, No 10 says, as Tories criticise welfare and tax proposals
Where you live will often have a big impact on your ability to find a job.
The Institute for Public Policy Research (IPPR) think tank used online job adverts to help identify the number of vacancies suitable for young people in the area they live, relative to the size of the local population.
It used AI to help identify the jobs, which were broadly defined as roles requiring relatively low experience or education.
According to its analysis, South Oxfordshire had 387 suitable vacancies per 1,000 18 to 24-year-olds in the area - the most of any local authority. Rotherham had the least, at 53 per 1,000.
Use this tool to check out the situation in your area. The data for London is only available for the region as a whole and is not broken down by individual councils.
Some people live in one area and work in another, but the analysis did not account for this.
Which sectors have the most entry-level jobs?
Even if there are jobs available in your area, you might not find one in the sector you want to work in.
The sector with the highest average number ofentry-level vacancies in the year to October was teaching, with most of those jobs being for teaching assistants, learning support and cover supervisor roles, according to jobs website Adzuna.
The next largest was hospitality and catering, traditionally an area where younger people get their first experience of work.
Adzuna, a major online jobs website, includes adverts for full-time roles marked as entry-level, those asking for up to two years' experience, graduate roles, internships and apprenticeships.
Accounting and finance had the third-highest number of job openings.
Figures on salaries for vacancies can be patchy because many employers do not include them in job adverts.
Prime Minister Andy Burnham recently urged businesses to start publishing salaries ahead ofplans to make pay details compulsory in adverts.
Only about 40% of Adzuna's jobs data for the year to October stated a salary, although that figure varies widely by sector.
Here are the average salaries for jobs in the sectors with the largest number of entry-level jobs, according to Adzuna. The highest average salary is£30,530 in engineering, while social care has the lowest at £25,880.
How many job vacancies are there overall?
While it can be hard for anyone looking for their first job, the situation is also tough for older jobseekers.
Across the whole economy there were 690,000 jobs available in the August to October period this year, which is the lowest number since early 2021.
The Covid pandemic led to huge swings in the number of job vacancies available as companies reacted to shutdowns and then reopened as restrictions were lifted.
Stripping out the fluctuations seen during the pandemic, the number of vacancies is now at its lowest level for 12 years.
Why Milburn's Neets reforms will only save £200m a year by 2036
Apprenticeships have often been a way for people to get their first taste of employment.
In England the number of people starting apprenticeships has risen in recent years, although this has been driven by an increase in those aged 25 and over after schemes for older workers were fully rolled out in 2008.
The number of people aged 24 and under starting apprenticeships in England in 2025 was 172,230, down from a peak of 291,300 in 2012.

fact_units.text: Where You Can Find Which GPU You Have In Your Windows PC
Finding your GPU takes a few built-in Windows tools and no screwdriver.
21, 2026 11:00 am ESTStenko Vlad/ShutterstockAdd Engadget on Google:Preferred SourceGoogle Discover
In case you didn't know, your Windows computer can house two graphics processors, and the one powering up your display isn't always the one keeping those games running.
Some laptops juggle integrated graphics for everyday use and a dedicated NVIDIA, AMD or Intel GPU for heavier workloads.
An Intel or AMD sticker on your system doesn't always tell you the whole story.
Confirming a game's requirements, troubleshooting system performance or deciding if your PC could use an upgrade first needs a proper look at the internals.
Thanks torising GPU pricesand AI data centers putting pressure on memory supplies, PC builders are already bearing the brunt of it.
It's best to know how capable your current setup is before you burn a hole in your wallet.
The good part is that Windows can easily identify your graphics hardware for you without needing any additional software or taking a screwdriver to your PC.
While Task Manager is the fastest way to go about it, there are a couple of other built-in tools you can use when the details are hidden in fine print.
Windows' Task Manager can do more than just flag which apps and services are eating up your computer's resources.
The Performance section gives you a clear look at the graphics card and spells out the details about its memory, driver and even the current workload it is under.
To open Task Manager, pressCtrl + Shift + Esc.
From the left sidebar in Windows 11, choosePerformanceor click the Performance tab at the top in Windows 10.
Click onGPU 0and find the model name of the graphics processor in the upper-right corner.
If you can seeGPU 1or other entries, take a look at those too.
Don't take the numbering of the GPUs at face value.
For instance, GPU 0 isn't always assigned to the more powerful graphics card or the one that's running all your games.
Windows simply labels the GPUs based on hardware location, and this has nothing to do with their performance.
You'll also find dedicated and shared GPU memory right under the performance graphs.
Dedicated memory usually refers tothe amount of VRAMthat's available on a dedicated GPU, while shared memory is regular system RAM that the GPU borrows when needed.
Some integrated GPUs even have a portion of system RAM reserved for graphics.
Windows reports this as dedicated memory, but an integrated GPU mostly relies on the system RAM.
Besides the GPU branding, you also get driver details, info about DirectX and even GPU temperature (if the hardware supports it) in Task Manager.
Your PC's Device Manager is exactly where you need to look for your GPU's name without any graphs involved.
To begin, right-click theStartbutton, selectDevice Managerfrom the list andexpandDisplay adapters.
You'll find all the graphics devices listed by Windows and also see whether your PC has both integrated and dedicated GPUs.
Once you find the GPU you want, double-click on it and open theDrivertab to check the installed driver version and date.
There's also the option to use the DirectX Diagnostic Tool.
TheDisplaytab will give you details about the GPU and drivers installed, and theSystemtab shows the DirectX version installed on your system.
If you seeMicrosoft Basic Display Adapterinstead of your graphics card's name in Device Manager, it means Windows is using a generic display driver.
While that doesn't always point to hardware issues, you may want toupdate your GPU driversbefore getting deeper into troubleshooting.
You can also use third-party apps like HWiNFO to track GPU temperatures, clock speeds and power readings, just as you wouldwhen checking CPU temperatures.

Waymo Recalls Robotaxis After They Drove Into Closed Freeway Lanes
Waymo recalls robotaxis after they drove into closed freeway lanes
The recalls come after the California DMV banned Waymo from operating on its state freeways.
ByJackson ChenNov. 21, 2026 11:01 am ESTWaymoAdd Engadget on Google:Preferred SourceGoogle Discover
Waymo filed a pair of recalls for its robotaxi fleet following incidents where its vehicles drove into closed freeway lanes and didn't follow manual commands from emergency responders. As first reported byReuters, the Alphabet-owned company said the two recalls were "to strengthen how the Waymo Driver navigates closed freeway lanes and intersections with manual traffic control." Waymo cars will operate normally on city streets, while freeway drives remain on pause as the company works on software improvements to address the issues.
Waymo filed the recalls with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration shortly after the California Department of Motor Vehiclesbanned its robotaxisfrom state freeway use. The state's DMV called the robotaxis an "imminent hazard to public safety" following a few incidents where Waymo vehicles drove into construction zones that were closed to traffic. According to the California DMV, three Waymo robotaxis entered restricted construction zones in the city of Burlingame on separate occasions. A Waymo robotaxi was also seen trying to navigate around a California Highway Patrol car that was performing a traffic break.
"Yesterday, we filed two voluntary recalls on our automated driving system to strengthen how the Waymo Driver navigates closed freeway lanes and intersections with manual traffic control," a Waymo spokesperson told Engadget. "These are standard steps in our rigorous safety approach to validating and refining our technology as we scale to more complex driving environments."
Waymo said that it's still working on a remedy for the closed freeway lanes recall, but added that there were no collisions or injuries from this issue, according toReuters. However, Waymo pushed out an update earlier this month to improve how its robotaxi fleet responds to manual commands from emergency responders, following a collision involving an officer directing traffic, as reported byReuters.
Earlier this year, Waymorecalled its robotaxisfor a similar issue where they would enter freeway construction zones at speed. The company eventuallyresumed freeway servicein the summer after identifying "an area of improvement regarding performance around freeway construction zones." Previously, Waymofiled a recallafter one of its robotaxis drove into a flooded road in San Antonio, Texas.

Waymo has stopped its robotaxis from driving on the freeway—here’s why - Ars TechnicaSkip to content
Text settingsStory textSizeSmallStandardLargeWidth*StandardWideLinksStandardOrange* Subscribers only
Waymo is currently restricting its fleet of robotaxis to surface streets after getting into hot water with California over its cars’ driving behavior on highways. Specifically, the software tends to drive into construction zones at speed. As first reported by theSan Francisco Business Times, this behavior actually drew the ire of California’s DMV earlier this month, which ordered Waymo to stop driving on Californian highways immediately and until it can convince the DMV that its cars no longer “pose an imminent hazard to public safety.”
This is not Waymo’s first run-in with this problem. In Arizona, Waymo robotaxis did not recognize ramp closure signs on six occasions in Phoenix in April and entered construction zones. A month later in California, seven Waymo robotaxis entered lanes with active construction. In June,Waymo recalledthe almost 3,800 robotaxis capable of highway driving. That problem led Waymo to stick to surface streets only in California after the May incidents until late July, when the robotaxis resumed highway operations.
In early July, Waymotoldthe National Highway Traffic Safety Administration that it began updating the robotaxi software to a version that “improve[s] the recognition of freeway construction zones, more appropriately prioritize[s] construction zones over other freeway hazards, and reduce[s] speed when the AV detects that it may be in a construction zone.”
Waymo also told the government that the updated software is better able to respond to emergency vehicles when in a construction zone and that the company has made “operational changes that better identify and mitigate potential entry into pre-planned construction zones and enable more Remote Assistance capability” if it happens again.
Which it has. Despite the update to improve behavior around emergency vehicles, a video went viral in early November showing a Waymo robotaxi on I-280 driving past a pair of California Highway Patrol cars conducting a rolling roadblock as they held traffic behind a slow-moving construction vehicle. California also says there was an incident in which a Waymo robotaxi entered a construction zone on US 101 near Burlingame.
“Safety is at the foundation of everything we do,” Waymo told Ars. “Following recent freeway construction zone encounters on U.S. 101 in California that did not involve any injuries or collisions, the California DMV has implemented an operating restriction on freeway operations in the state. In alignment with our safety-first principles, we have also temporarily restricted freeway operations across our other operating markets to evaluate our performance. Our ride-hailing service continues to operate safely on surface streets, serving over half a million trips each week. We are working with the California DMV and other state officials diligently and responsibly to resume freeway operations.”
Waymo also told Ars it was continuing to work with the various California agencies that regulate transport.
Until the suspension, Waymo was only conducting highway operations in Los Angeles and the Bay Area in California, as well as in Arizona.

Waymo suspends freeway rides nationwide after California DMV order | TechCrunch
Waymo suspends freeway rides nationwide after California DMV order
Kirsten Korosec11:49 AM PST · November 17, 2026
Waymo robotaxis are no longer allowed to operate on California freeways after the state’s Department of Motor Vehicles restricted the Alphabet-owned company’s operations following several incidents that raised safety concerns.
California’s DMV, which regulates the testing and deployment of autonomous vehicles in the state, issued the operational restrictions on Waymo on November 11. However, the restrictions weren’t made public until Tuesday. San Francisco Business Times was thefirst to reportthe order.
The DMV confirmed the new restrictions to TechCrunch, stating that the department took action after three Waymo autonomous vehicles entered an active construction closure on U.S. Route 101 near Burlingame, and another separate incident involving California Highway Patrol vehicles on Highway 280 in San Francisco.
Waymo has complied and is preventing its robotaxis from accessing freeways in any of the markets it operates in, including those outside of California. Waymo currently has commercial operations in 15 U.S. cities.
The DMV said Waymo’s freeway operations pose an imminent hazard to public safety.
“The Department determined that Waymo’s driverless freeway operations pose an imminent hazard to public safety due to recurring incursions by its vehicles into active construction zones where construction workers, vehicles and equipment are present, despite a prior restriction and corrective actions implemented following similar incidents that occurred on May 18, 2026,” according to an emailed statement sent to TechCrunch.
The DMV said the restrictions will remain in place until Waymo can demonstrate that it has taken “effective corrective actions” to address the deficiencies.
Waymo spokesperson Dana Gallagher told TechCrunch the company has temporarily restricted freeway operations across its other operating markets to evaluate its performance.
“Safety is at the foundation of everything we do,” Gallagher said in a statement. “Following recent freeway construction zone encounters on U.S. 101 in California that did not involve any injuries or collisions, the California DMV has implemented an operating restriction on freeway operations in the state. In alignment with our safety-first principles, we have also temporarily restricted freeway operations across our other operating markets to evaluate our performance. Our ride-hailing service continues to operate safely on surface streets, serving over half a million trips each week. We are working with the California DMV and other state officials diligently and responsibly to resume freeway operations.”
Waymo began offeringfreeway rides in late 2025, a commercial milestone that has been central to its expansion in major metro areas. Freeway access allows Waymo to connect riders to airports and other destinations more efficiently, slashing travel times by avoiding slower surface streets.
That has been particularly important in the San Francisco Bay Area because Waymo’s service area stretches from the city south to Silicon Valley. Freeway access has dramatically shortened trips across the Peninsula that previously took 45 minutes or more than an hour.
In May, Waymo abruptlystopped operatingon highways. The company didn’t cite a specific reason at the time, but several social media posts showed Waymo robotaxis driving through traffic cones and struggling to navigate construction zones.
Waymo robotaxisreturned to freewaysin July after the company said it updated the self-driving software system to improve performance around freeway construction zones.

England 37-12 New Zealand: Hosts run up record win over All Blacks - BBC Sport
Image source,Getty ImagesImage caption,
Seb Atkinson scored England's fifth and final try
ByMike HensonBBC Sport rugby union news reporter at Allianz Stadium
Tries:Slade, Van Poortvliet, Earl, Chessum, AtkinsonCons:F Smith (2), M SmithPens:M Smith (2)
Tries:De Groot, B BarrettCons:McKenzie
England's revival roared up a gear as they beat New Zealand by a record margin after former captain Lewis Moody led the hosts' response to the haka.
Moody, who was diagnosed with motor neurone disease last year, stood at the centre of a flying V formation that England had adopted for their victories over the same opponents last year and in the 2019 Rugby World Cup semi-final.
In terms of margin, this win trumped both - and the other seven England victories in the teams' 121-year rivalry.
And the hosts were full value for it. They dominated the All Blacks from the start.
Henry Slade crossed for the opening try in the fourth minute and only England's own mistakes prevented them taking a bigger lead than their 19-5 advantage into the break.
Beauden Barrett marked his 150th Test appearance by rounding off a coast-to-coast Kiwi try to cut England's advantage to 24-12. But his team never really threatened to reel in Steve Borthwick's men.
England introduced five forwards off the bench in the immediate aftermath of that 55th-minute score and, with Ellis Genge in fearsome carrying form, they had more than enough to see out victory in comfort.
Seb Atkinson took a delayed pop pass from Marcus Smith to stroll in for England's fifth try just after the hour.
The hosts finished the game camped down in the New Zealand 22m in search of a sixth score while choruses of Swing Low rolled around the stands.
For New Zealand, who suffered a shock defeat by Wales last weekend, it is a result that suggests a long Test season, which included four Tests against South Africa, may be catching up with them.
By contrast England, who could still end up in next weekend's Nations Championship grand final depending on results, are riding a wave of confidence.

fact_units.text: England 37-12 New Zealand: Hosts run up record win over All Blacks - BBC Sport
ByMike HensonBBC Sport rugby union news reporter at Allianz Stadium
Tries:Slade, Van Poortvliet, Earl, Chessum, AtkinsonCons:F Smith (2), M SmithPens:M Smith (2)
England's revival roared up a gear as they beat New Zealand by a record margin after former captain Lewis Moody led the hosts' response to the haka.

Moody, who was diagnosed with motor neurone disease last year, stood at the centre of a flying V formation that England had adopted for their victories over the same opponents last year and in the 2019 Rugby World Cup semi-final.
In terms of margin, this win trumped both - and the other seven England victories in the teams' 121-year rivalry.
Henry Slade crossed for the opening try in the fourth minute and only England's own mistakes prevented them taking a bigger lead than their 19-5 advantage into the break.
Beauden Barrett marked his 150th Test appearance by rounding off a coast-to-coast Kiwi try to cut England's advantage to 24-12.
But his team never really threatened to reel in Steve Borthwick's men.

England introduced five forwards off the bench in the immediate aftermath of that 55th-minute score and, with Ellis Genge in fearsome carrying form, they had more than enough to see out victory in comfort.
Seb Atkinson took a delayed pop pass from Marcus Smith to stroll in for England's fifth try just after the hour.
The hosts finished the game camped down in the New Zealand 22m in search of a sixth score while choruses of Swing Low rolled around the stands.
For New Zealand, who suffered a shock defeat by Wales last weekend, it is a result that suggests a long Test season, which included four Tests against South Africa, may be catching up with them.
By contrast England, who could still end up in next weekend's Nations Championship grand final depending on results, are riding a wave of confidence.

Mexican special forces have arrested Fausto Isidro Meza-Flores,an alleged cartel leader known as “Chapo Isidro”,who is on the FBI’s Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list, Mexico’s defence ministry said.
Meza-Flores was detained along with two other men on Friday night in Guasave, in the northwestern state of Sinaloa.

The arrest comes as US President Donald Trump has beenpressing Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum to do moreto combat drug cartels and said on Friday that Washington was working with Sheinbaum “because the cartels are running Mexico.”
“I told her that,” he said. “And we can’t let the cartels run Mexico. They’re our neighbour.”
Who is Chapo Isidro and what is he accused of?
Despite the similar nickname, Meza-Flores is not related to Joaquin “El Chapo” Guzman, the jailed former leader of the Sinaloa Cartel.
Mexican authorities say Meza-Flores leads the Beltran Leyva criminal organisation and is an ally of the Mayos faction of the Sinaloa Cartel. The Mexican Secretariat of National Defence said he was wanted in Mexico on an arrest warrant for organised crime and drug offences and is subject to an extradition order to the United States.
US prosecutors first indicted Meza-Flores in 2012. In a 2019 indictment, they accused him of conspiring to manufacture and distribute cocaine, heroin, methamphetamine and marijuana for the US market between 2005 and 2019. He also faces a firearms charge.
The FBIadded him to its Ten Most Wanted Fugitives listin February 2025, and the US Department of State offered up to $5m for information leading to his arrest and conviction.
“Known as El Chapo Isidro, he’s accused of spending the last 20 years flooding the US with fentanyl, cocaine, heroin, and other deadly drugs, first as an independent drug trafficker and later as the head of the Meza-Flores cartel,” said then-acting FBI Director Brian Driscoll in announcing his addition to the list.
He also said Meza-Flores and his organisation were accused of kidnapping, extortion, torture and murder.
Mexico’s defence ministry said the operation followed coordination between Mexican and US intelligence agencies and involved special forces from Mexico’s National Guard and army.
Troops used “stealth and surprise” to establish a security perimeter around a house in Guasave and came under attack with gunfire and explosives before entering and arresting three men, the ministry said.
It identified the other two as German N, known as “Serafin”, the group’s alleged second-in-command, and Jose N, who they identified as a financial operator. The three men were flown to Mexico City and handed over to prosecutors.
Sinaloa’s public security agency urged residents to stay indoors, avoid the area, and stay off the roads, as federal personnel had been attacked in Guasave.
The defence ministry said roadblocks were reported in four areas of Sinaloa after the arrests and that security forces were sent to reopen roads.
Videos from Guasave showed people fleeing gunfire at a baseball game, as well as cars and petrol stations on fire, The Associated Press news agency reported.
Mexico’s security secretary, Omar Garcia Harfuch, said on Saturday that troops would remain in Sinaloa to protect residents.
“These detentions are an important step toward restoring peace in Sinaloa,” he wrote on X.

Mexico captures FBI’s most-wanted cartel boss ‘El Chapo Isidro’, triggering violence | Euronews
ByNela HeidnerPublished on21 November 2026 - 15:20 GMT+1ShareFacebookTwitterFlipboardSendRedditLinkedinMessengerTelegramVKBlueskyThreadsWhatsapp
Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, one of the FBI’s ten most-wanted fugitives, was arrested in a military operation involving US intelligence cooperation. Gunfire, burning vehicles and panic among civilians followed the raid in northern Mexico.
Mexican security forces have captured notorious cartel leader Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, better known as ‘El Chapo Isidro’, in the north-western state of Sinaloa, triggering a wave of violence that sent residents fleeing for safety.
The arrest took place in Guasave on Friday night, 20 November, during an operation involving Mexican military and security forces. The Mexican government said intelligence provided by the administration of US President Donald Trump had contributed to the operation, although it has not disclosed precisely how the two countries co-operated.
The arrest was followed by armed confrontations, burning vehicles and roadblocks. Disturbing footage circulating on social media showed spectators fleeing in panic as gunfire interrupted a baseball match in Guasave.
Military operation and US intelligence cooperation
According to Mexican authorities, security forces used what they described as ‘stealth and surprise’ to apprehend Meza Flores.
The operation involved specialist units from the Mexican National Guard and Army. Officials said their personnel came under attack from armed individuals using firearms and explosives, believed to be cartel operatives.
Following the exchange of fire, security forces entered a property and arrested Meza Flores, along with other individuals.
The detainees were subsequently evacuated aboard a Mexican Air Force aircraft to Mexico City, according to the authorities.
The Mexican government acknowledged that intelligence supplied by the Trump administration had played a role in locating and capturing the cartel leader. However, officials have so far provided few details about the intelligence-sharing arrangements or the extent of American involvement.
Mexican news outlet N+ also reported that intelligence agencies from Mexico's Defence Ministry and the United States had co-operated in the operation.
The development highlights the importance of intelligence cooperation between Mexico and the United States in tackling organised crime, particularly given the cross-border nature of the drug trade.
Gunfire interrupts baseball match as residents flee
The arrest quickly turned into a night of violence in Guasave.
Videos and photographs shared online showed civilians running for cover as gunfire erupted during a baseball match. Spectators could be seen leaving the venue in fear as the situation deteriorated.
Other footage showed vehicles set alight and roads blocked, while armed confrontations reportedly spread beyond the immediate area of the operation.
According to Mexican newspaperLa Jornada, the violence included shootings, vehicle fires, roadblocks involving burning lorries and clashes between federal forces and armed groups.
Local authorities urged residents to remain indoors and avoid travelling on affected roads.
The scenes illustrate the immediate risks that major operations against organised crime can pose to civilians living in areas where criminal groups maintain a strong presence.
No reliable overall casualty figure was established in the initial reports.
Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as ‘El Chapo Isidro’, is considered one of Mexico's most significant organised-crime figures.
He is associated with the Beltrán Leyva criminal organisation and leads a network also known as the Meza-Flores organisation or the Guasave Cartel.
The FBI wanted poster for Fausto Isidro Meza-Flores.FBI.gov
The group has operated primarily in north-western Mexico, particularly in Sinaloa, and has been linked by US authorities to the trafficking of several illegal drugs, including cocaine, methamphetamine, heroin and marijuana.
Meza Flores rose to prominence following the fragmentation of the Beltrán Leyva organisation and the wider conflicts between rival criminal factions in Mexico.
His organisation has been accused of using violence, intimidation and territorial control to protect its criminal activities.
In February 2025, the FBI placed Meza Flores on its Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list, underlining the importance US authorities attached to his capture.
The US government had offered a reward of up to US$5 million for information leading to his arrest.
Although the arrest is a major achievement for Mexican security forces, it remains to be seen how it will affect the balance of power between criminal organisations operating in Sinaloa.
The capture of a senior cartel figure does not necessarily mean the dismantling of the organisation he leads. Criminal networks can remain operational following the arrest of their leaders, while rival groups may attempt to exploit any resulting power vacuum.
The immediate unrest highlights the continuing challenges facing the country in its fight against organised crime.

Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out - BBC News
Fausto Isidro "Chapo Isidro" Meza Flores was detained by Mexican special forces on Friday
A Mexican drug lord who was on the FBI's 10 most wanted list has been arrested following a shoot-out with Mexican authorities.
Fausto Isidro "Chapo Isidro" Meza Flores was detained along with his lieutenant by Mexican special forces in Guasave, Sinaloa on Friday, Mexico's defence secretariat said.
Meza Flores was wanted in Mexico on organised crime charges, while he has been accused of "flooding the US with fentanyl, cocaine, heroin and other deadly drugs" by the FBI. The US is seeking his extradition.
Mexico has stepped up efforts to tackle drug-related crime after coming under pressure from US President Donald Trump since he returned to the White House.
Meza Flores, the leader of the Meza Flores Organisation, also known as the Guasave Cartel, is thought to have been active in the drug trafficking trade since the 1990s but managed to evade authorities till now by maintaining a relatively low profile.
Using US intelligence on his whereabouts, Mexican special forces descended on his location using "stealth and surprise", establishing a perimeter to prevent him from escaping and reinforcements arriving, Mexico's defence secretariat said.
However, they "came under attack from gunfire and explosives" before entering the property and arresting Meza Flores and his second-in-command, it added.
Videos circulating online appear to show helicopters firing streams of bullets towards the ground in Guasave. Others appear to show people at a baseball stadium fleeing as they hear shooting sounds.
A number of vehicles were pictured burning on a highway near Los Mochis, Sinaloa, after Fausto Isidro "Chapo Idisro" Meza Flores was arrested
The two detainees were subsequently flown to Mexico City to face prosecution, the defence secretariat said.
When he was added to the FBI's most-wanted list in 2025, he was accused of "heinous crimes" including kidnapping, extortion and torture.
Then-acting FBI director Brian Driscoll said Meza Flores and his organisation had also unleashed a "scourge of illicit drugs" into the US via its southern border with Mexico.
He was initially charged with drug trafficking in the US in 2012 before being charged again in 2019.
The 44-year-old is alleged to have conspired to manufacture and distribute large quantities of cocaine, heroin, methamphetamine and marijuana between 2005 and 2019.
Meza Flores was originally a high-ranking member of the Beltrán Leyva Organization, but a split between rival factions led to a surge of violence and prompted him to establish his own cartel by 2013.
His organisation has also engaged in what US officials described as an "extremely violent turf war" with the Sinaloa Cartel, one of the most powerful drug trafficking gangs, which operates in the same region.
Meza Flores was added to the FBI's most-wanted list after Mexican authorities reportedly linked his cartel to 20 million fentanyl pills they seized in 2024.
Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum has taken a tougher stance on the country's cartels in a bid to resist US intervention on Mexican soil. Mexico has welcomed closer collaboration but resisted US boots on the ground.
Trump made stemming the flow of drugs into the US across its southern border one of his key election pledges.

NWSL, U.S. Soccer continue focus on women's soccer growth with player and executive development programs
The NWSL announced the creation of the player development rule on Thursday, as well as the Sporting Executive Leadership Program in conjunction with U.S. Soccer and FIFA
ByPardeep CattryNov 21, 2026at 10:37 am ET•9 min readGetty Images
WASHINGTON, D.C. –The NWSL has always been a measuring stick for the growth of women's soccer in the U.S., which in recent years has beenheadlined by skyrocketing expansion feesand increased fan engagement. There's a buzzword that continues to pop up around the league, one that is rarely associated with the key performance indicators – pipeline. After she read out another list of attendance figures and viewership numbers before the 2026 season wraps up with Saturday's NWSL Championship (8 p.m. ET,CBS,Paramount+), commissioner Jessica Berman made a hard pivot in her state of the league remarks on Thursday to say the league is officially in the business of prioritizing said pipeline.
In the first of four announcements she teased was in service of that. The NWSL announced two initiatives on Thursday:the creation of a player development rule (PDR) and a sporting executive leadership program, designed specifically to focus on the foundation of the league's structure. The plans are a marriage of the league's business model and sporting objectives, a tacit understanding that the two go hand-in-hand, especially for a league that isadmittedly driven by star power. These new plans, though, are hardly the only initiatives that will influence the pipeline.
The NWSL's new initiatives reflect a shifting focus across the American soccer landscape, one that seemsdriven by the heightened interest in the sportcourtesy of this year's World Cup in North America. The league's financial stability enabled this shift but beyond that, there are overlapping commitments across the industry to finally fix one of American soccer's most evident problems – the pipeline. The sport's success in this country has often comein spiteof a fractured youth soccer system, one that U.S. Soccer hopes to unite in the coming years.
The parties, be it in conjunction or individually, are also dead set on ensuring the women's game is held in equal regard to the men's every step of the way.
The PDR joins a list of NWSL rules in recent years that have incentivized clubs to recruit young players more easily such as the U-18 Entry Mechanism andorganizing its first-ever combinelast year. The new rule requires participating clubs to develop a curriculum that supports player development and is tied directly to salary cap relief.
"What can we do at the league to motivate and incentivize clubs to develop players?" Sarah Gregorius, the NWSL's vice president of sporting, told CBS Sports. "What do we have in our toolkit? And one of the things we obviously have in our toolkit is a salary cap and we can use that as a motivation and as an incentive to encourage the types of behavior around player development that we want to see, and hopefully, it's really our first structural foray into player development. Again, it's deliberately an incentive. It's not a mandate. It's up to the clubs. If they want to participate, if they want to access the reward, they know what they have to do in order to do that."
There is a perceived industry standard about developing young players, even if it is as far from an exact science as it gets. Academy systems tied to clubs are how players often come up the ranks – that is true across the men's game including in MLS and increasingly so for women's players in Europe. The NWSL does not have a streamlined system that mirrors the academy set-up and interestingly enough, is not actually trying to go in that direction.
"This is a pretty unique country," Gregorius said. "It doesn't actually work to pick something up from overseas and plop it down over here and I'm actually not convinced in the two years that I've spent here and everything that I've learned that this vertical academy system across the clubs makes the most sense. There's already a ton of incredible player development happening. There's just a bit of a lack of cohesion and a lack of connection to the professional game … The Spanish model won't work here, the German model wouldn't work here, the Japanese model wouldn't work here. Got a ton of respect for what they're doing in their countries but the reason that it works is it's for those countries. We have to do something that works for this one, which has characteristics that no other country in the world has. F---, this place is big. It's dynamic. There's a lot going on."
Gregorius believes a league-issued mandate might further fracture an already splintered landscape.
"If I think about it from a local level, some of our clubs are in markets that have thriving youth ecosystems, right?" Gregorius started. "So if all of a sudden there was a mandate from the league that every single club – which is what they do in England – has to come in and have a professional game academy, they're going to all of a sudden have to start pulling players out of those environments, which is disruptive for the kids. It's disruptive for the families. Some of those kids and families are also fans of the team. It's the icing on the cake in those particular markets so all of a sudden, you create tension. You create tension for the parents. You create tension for the kids. You create tension within the fan groups. They're like, 'Well, no, actually. You've stripped out my youth club in order to service a mandate from the league, not paying attention to the fact that all of your talented players have come through the system.' That's not what we want. That's bad for player development and it's bad for fan engagement, to be honest."
The NWSL is distinguishing itself from MLS, a league to which it has no formal ties but one that committed to the traditional academy system over a decade ago and can count it amongst its greatest successes. Soccer continue focus on women's soccer growth with player and executive development programs
The NWSL announced the creation of the player development rule on Thursday, as well as the Sporting Executive Leadership Program in conjunction with U.S.
ByPardeep CattryNov 21, 2026at 10:37 am ET•9 min readGetty Images
–The NWSL has always been a measuring stick for the growth of women's soccer in the U.S., which in recent years has beenheadlined by skyrocketing expansion feesand increased fan engagement.
There's a buzzword that continues to pop up around the league, one that is rarely associated with the key performance indicators – pipeline.
After she read out another list of attendance figures and viewership numbers before the 2026 season wraps up with Saturday's NWSL Championship (8 p.m.
ET,CBS,Paramount+), commissioner Jessica Berman made a hard pivot in her state of the league remarks on Thursday to say the league is officially in the business of prioritizing said pipeline.
In the first of four announcements she teased was in service of that.

The NWSL announced two initiatives on Thursday:the creation of a player development rule (PDR) and a sporting executive leadership program, designed specifically to focus on the foundation of the league's structure.
The plans are a marriage of the league's business model and sporting objectives, a tacit understanding that the two go hand-in-hand, especially for a league that isadmittedly driven by star power.
These new plans, though, are hardly the only initiatives that will influence the pipeline.

The NWSL's new initiatives reflect a shifting focus across the American soccer landscape, one that seemsdriven by the heightened interest in the sportcourtesy of this year's World Cup in North America.

The league's financial stability enabled this shift but beyond that, there are overlapping commitments across the industry to finally fix one of American soccer's most evident problems – the pipeline.
The sport's success in this country has often comein spiteof a fractured youth soccer system, one that U.S.
The parties, be it in conjunction or individually, are also dead set on ensuring the women's game is held in equal regard to the men's every step of the way.
The PDR joins a list of NWSL rules in recent years that have incentivized clubs to recruit young players more easily such as the U-18 Entry Mechanism andorganizing its first-ever combinelast year.
The new rule requires participating clubs to develop a curriculum that supports player development and is tied directly to salary cap relief.
"What can we do at the league to motivate and incentivize clubs to develop players?" Sarah Gregorius, the NWSL's vice president of sporting, told CBS Sports.

And one of the things we obviously have in our toolkit is a salary cap and we can use that as a motivation and as an incentive to encourage the types of behavior around player development that we want to see, and hopefully, it's really our first structural foray into player development.
If they want to participate, if they want to access the reward, they know what they have to do in order to do that."
There is a perceived industry standard about developing young players, even if it is as far from an exact science as it gets.
Academy systems tied to clubs are how players often come up the ranks – that is true across the men's game including in MLS and increasingly so for women's players in Europe.
The NWSL does not have a streamlined system that mirrors the academy set-up and interestingly enough, is not actually trying to go in that direction.

"It doesn't actually work to pick something up from overseas and plop it down over here and I'm actually not convinced in the two years that I've spent here and everything that I've learned that this vertical academy system across the clubs makes the most sense.
There's already a ton of incredible player development happening.

There's just a bit of a lack of cohesion and a lack of connection to the professional game … The Spanish model won't work here, the German model wouldn't work here, the Japanese model wouldn't work here.
Got a ton of respect for what they're doing in their countries but the reason that it works is it's for those countries.
We have to do something that works for this one, which has characteristics that no other country in the world has.
Gregorius believes a league-issued mandate might further fracture an already splintered landscape.
"If I think about it from a local level, some of our clubs are in markets that have thriving youth ecosystems, right?" Gregorius started.

"So if all of a sudden there was a mandate from the league that every single club – which is what they do in England – has to come in and have a professional game academy, they're going to all of a sudden have to start pulling players out of those environments, which is disruptive for the kids.
Some of those kids and families are also fans of the team.
It's the icing on the cake in those particular markets so all of a sudden, you create tension.

You've stripped out my youth club in order to service a mandate from the league, not paying attention to the fact that all of your talented players have come through the system.' That's not what we want.
That's bad for player development and it's bad for fan engagement, to be honest."

The NWSL is distinguishing itself from MLS, a league to which it has no formal ties but one that committed to the traditional academy system over a decade ago and can count it amongst its greatest successes.
There's no stigma associated with the diverging path, though – U.S.

The Washington Spirit won it all in 2021 but came up just short in each of the last two finals. This may be the day that Trinity Rodman gets her second crown.
The Kansas City Current bring plenty to the final and may just be the favorites. They're back in the big game for the first time since 2022 after endingNJ/NY Gotham FC'stitle defense in the semis. Croix Bethune, who used to play for the Spirit, curled in a free-kick stunner, andHaley Hopkinswon it in the 89th minute.

The Current, though, are in the same boat --they have struggled without their all-star trio, but each of Croix Bethune,Temwa Chawingaand Michelle Cooper will be available on Saturday and equally capable of turning the game in their favor.

Both teams have experienced players and rising stars, and it'll be a combo of chess and tug of war during the NWSL Championship. It's a fascinating match for both sides and one where the margins will be thin but being able to have a strong attack led by Trinity Rodman along with a buildup that Andi Sullivan keeps control of. If the Spirit can control the pace, it will be a long day for Kansas City but Croix Bethune will have ideas of her own as well.-- Chuck Booth

Washington Spirit:Truthfully, the pressure is on the Washington Spirit headed into this one, and that typically doesn't play out the best for teams who are the higher seed or considered favorites on paper. Kansas City will be a more than worthy opponent, but the Spirit's third time in the final comes with a long home build-up through and back to Audi Field, and any mental component needed will come with a boost from the crowd environment.-- Sandra Herrera

She has always been key to the Spirit's success but hit a new level this season, to the point that she had a very valid MVP case even if her ex-teammate Ashley Sanchez took it home instead after a record-breaking season with theNorth Carolina Courage. Rodman's ability to create and score chances means she's very likely to have a say on Saturday, one that could very well end the Spirit's five-year wait for another championship.-- Pardeep Cattry

Trinity Rodman out to prove she is true NWSL MVP as Washington Spirit aim for other side of Champinship hump
Trinity Rodman has been the face of the NWSL for nearly her entire professional career.
Drafted by the Washington Spirit as the youngest player in NWSL history in 2021, and signed as the highest-paid player in the league later that year, Rodman is used to being a trend-setter.
Now 24 years old and still thriving as one of the biggest — if notTHEbiggest — star on the U.S. women's national team, Rodman has led the Spirit to the 2026 NWSL Championship, hoping to secure their first league title since her rookie season.
Just a few days before the match, Rodman was in attendance at the NWSL postseason award gala, having been nominated for the league's MVP award.
"It would mean the world,"Rodman saidbefore the ceremony of potentially winning league MVP. "That's one that I've always wanted, I think everybody wants that one. It would mean a lot to me, and I would love for that to happen."
It didn't happen, as Rodman lost to a deserving Ashley Sanchez. The North Carolina Courage forward enjoyed a spectacular season, finishing as the NWSL leading goal scorer while equaling the league's single-season scoring record. While Rodman didn't win the award this year, she found the time and grace to record and post a TikTok dance with Sanchez, a close friend, proving she has no ill will towards the victor.
We are already winning the NWSL Championship weekend because we got a Trinity Rodman and Ashley Sanchez tiktok 🫶 🎥 @trinity_rodman https://t.co/LVPNrLMJCG
— The Women's Game (@WomensGameMIB)November 19, 2026
Sanchez absolutely put forth the best individual performance through the 2026 NWSL season, which MVP awards typically honor. But if you're looking for the true "most valuable player" in the NWSL, it's undoubtedly Rodman. With 12 goals and eight assists this season, her goal contributions were instrumental in the Spirit's push to the title match. Meanwhile, Sanchez's Courage didn't even qualify for the postseason.
This year, though, feels different. While other top NWSL teams such as Shield winners Gotham faded towards the end of the season due to injuries and dip in form, Rodman and the Spirit are peaking at the perfect time. After scoring in the regular season finale against basement-dwelling Chicago, Rodman has bagged two goals — a brace against Portland in the quarterfinals – and two assists in their two playoff games to this point.
"Going into [a championship game] not 100 percent isn’t the greatest feeling because you know that you’re still going to play, but you don’t know if it’s going to be a great performance,"Rodman told reporterson Thursday at a pre-match event in D.C. "So to be healthy and to be able to give everything that I have is really exciting for me.”
I spoke to the Washington Spirit’s Trinity Rodman about the club serving as a beacon during a very trying time for many of us here in DC. She spoke of inclusivity, of family, and of safety. Much more, on the Guardian. https://t.co/6ccUFWyUCx https://t.co/A2nlgqVpW1
— Pablo Iglesias Maurer (@MLSist)November 20, 2026
You see, Washington has made the title match in each of the last three seasons now, but they lost both of the previous two. Last season, Rodman suffered a back injury that ruined the second half of the campaign, and even though she came back to play in the final, she wasn't quite the same. In 2024, Rodman failed to register a goal or assist in the last seven games of the season, including any of their three playoff games, as the Spirit lost to Orlando.
"I think it's just like, full-circle moment obviously with it being in D.C." Rodmantold ESPN's Futbol W showon Thursday. "just starting my pro career here and then re-signing to stay and play here, everything that I've been through just with the fans here, the community, everything, and how much the fan base has grown. To be able to do that in this city will be the most rewarding thing and very celebratory."
Rodman has already won an NWSL Championship, her very first year in the league, and she has already lost the 2026 NWSL MVP award. And yet, there is still so much on the line in Saturday's final. Winning the 2026 title would elevate Rodman's club resume from good to great, even without the individual honor.
Trinity Rodman doesn't need an NWSL MVP award to prove she's the league's most valuable player. She's done that all season long, and she can put on the finishing touches Saturday on her home turf, with a Championship win capping off a truly remarkable campaign and cementing Rodman as the biggest superstar the league has to offer.

NWSL final tickets top $350 in ‘perfect storm’ even after fall from $755 peak | NWSL | The GuardianSkip to main contentSkip to navigation
Sandy MacIver (left) and Andi Sullivan of the Washington Spirit speak during a press conference at Audi Field on Friday, ahead of Saturday’s NWSL Championship final against the Kansas City Current.Photograph: Hannah Foslien/NWSL/Getty ImagesView image in fullscreenSandy MacIver (left) and Andi Sullivan of the Washington Spirit speak during a press conference at Audi Field on Friday, ahead of Saturday’s NWSL Championship final against the Kansas City Current.Photograph: Hannah Foslien/NWSL/Getty Images
NWSL final tickets top $350 in ‘perfect storm’ even after fall from $755 peak
Get-in price peaked at $755 before dropping to $362
Previous NWSL finals never topped $100 on matchday
Analyst cites Spirit home game and thin resale supply
The get-in price for tickets toSaturday’s NWSL Championship matchplunged more than 50% this week but was still set to finish at more than three times the previous record for an NWSL final.
After the Washington Spiritbooked their spot in the finalagainst the Kansas City Current with a semi-final victory last Saturday, the get-in price for the championship match spiked as high as $755 that same night, according to TicketData.com. However, that price had dropped as low as $308 on Friday morning before climbing back to $362 by midday.
Washington Spirit v Kansas City Current: where the NWSL Championship will be won and lostRead more
While representing a 52.1% drop from Saturday’s high, the get-in price for previous NWSL championship matches has never settled higher than $100, according to TicketData.com. Last year’s championship match between the Spirit andGotham FCin San Jose settled at a get-in price of $64.
The Spirit will be playing in their home stadium at Audi Field, contributing to the record ticket-price pace. Unlike most playoff matches, the NWSL Championship is awarded to a host city well in advance, making the Spirit’s appearance in the final a particularly fortunate coincidence for the league. Kansas City earned their spotwith a dramatic 2-1 win over Gotham FCon Sunday afternoon.
US ticketing analyst Keith Smith described the extraordinary prices as a “perfect storm”, pointing to the Spirit’s home-field advantage and unusually limited ticket availability on the resale market. Because NWSL matches have not traditionally attracted significant interest from ticket resellers, hesaid on social media, there has been little inventory available on secondary-market platforms throughout the week.
For comparison, the get-in price for last year’s MLS Cup, won by Inter Miami in South Florida, settled at $271 after peaking at $806. Smith noted that tickets for that match, featuringLionel Messi, were available in the mid-$200s on match day – considerably less than the cheapest seats for Saturday’s NWSL final.
Smith also pointed to the record prices forthis year’s WNBA finalsas further evidence of the growing commercial appeal of women’s sports. The two championship events, taking place just weeks apart, have underscored a surge in demand that would have been difficult to imagine in previous years, when NWSL final did not always sell out.
NWSL commissioner Jessica Berman said this week that high ticket prices for the championship represent a “good problem to have”.
